artworks.title: Dumfries Bridge
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with two large trees framing the view. A bridge crosses a calm body of water in a town, with buildings and trees in the distance. Hills roll upward towards a sky. There are two small figures standing to the right. The scene uses a monochromatic color palette with black, grey, and white, typical of an etching technique with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Melville Castle from Eldin
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a castle in a rural setting. The horizon line divides the sky from the forest below, where the castle is surrounded by trees. The artwork seems to be an etching or engraving with detailed linework, showcasing textures. The trees on the right have dense cross-hatching for depth. The color scheme is monochromatic using black and white for contrast. A path with figures and a horse-drawn cart can be seen in the lower area.

artworks.title: Borthwick Castle
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows Borthwick Castle from an elevated perspective. The castle stands in the middle distance, surrounded by trees. The stone structure has towers and fortified walls. The scene is detailed with fine line work, resembling an etching. A monochromatic color palette of brown tones creates a vintage look. In the foreground, small buildings and trees suggest a village. The terrain slopes upward to the castle. Figures near the castle provide scale. The sky has sparse cloud details.

artworks.title: Stirling from Kinneil
artworks.medium: etching touched with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a distant horizon, hills, a settlement, and a body of water. The scene is detailed with trees, using delicate brushstrokes and an etching technique. The color palette is mostly monochromatic, with shades of grey and black. An building and trees frame the landscape.

artworks.title: Stirling from Kinnell
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape seen from above, with a body of water in the foreground and hills or mountains in the distance. The horizon is at the top of the image, where the land meets the sky. Various landforms resembling mountains or large hills are visible along the horizon, with a settlement or structure on one peak. The artwork features intricate etching with fine lines creating texture and depth, especially in the foliage and water reflections. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black, gray, and white to highlight contrasts. Trees and a building are in the foreground, while in the distance, there is a peaceful body of water with faint vertical elements such as poles or small boats. The scene conveys a sense of serene natural beauty with a hint of human presence.

artworks.title: Dalhousie Castle I
artworks.medium: etching wtih drypoint on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image features a castle-like structure prominently situated in the center of a composition. The structure is detailed with towers and stonework captured through delicate linework. Surrounding the structure are trees, foliage, and greenery depicted with rich textures. The color palette is monochromatic in varying intensities of black and gray. The sky is mostly clear with speckling effects.

artworks.title: Eddystone Lighthouse
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with turbulent waves crashing towards a lighthouse standing amidst the stormy sea. Two sailing ships are seen on either side of the lighthouse. The etching technique creates a textured appearance with dynamic movement depicted in the waves and sky. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of gray, intensifying the dramatic atmosphere. The lighthouse is the focal point against a lighter background.

artworks.title: Melville Milne
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a structured estate as the focal point. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, revealing a broad expanse with a courtyard at the center surrounded by buildings. In the background, there is a faint silhouette of a mountain range or hill. The artwork features fine and detailed brushstrokes or etching lines depicting lush vegetation and architectural elements. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of black and gray against an off-white background. Trees form a barrier closest to the viewer, directing the gaze towards the buildings and grounds beyond.

artworks.title: Newark Castle II
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image displays a historic stone structure with turrets and rectangular windows, surrounded by trees. The detailed etching style emphasizes textures in the castle and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white for contrast. A group of figures is on the path towards the structure. Trees frame the castle, and the sky has a light texture.

artworks.title: Crichton Castle from the Northeast
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a castle in the center. The horizon is high, hills merge with the sky filled with clouds. A tree is on the left, and a path leads to the castle, with shrubs surrounding it. The colors are primarily black and gray. The lines and hatching add texture and dimension.

artworks.title: Borthwick Castle from the Southwest
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows Borthwick Castle on a hill, with the horizon obscured by the castle and surrounding foliage. The style is fine etching lines creating intricate details and contrasts, particularly in the stone walls and foliage textures. The monochromatic color palette uses black on a cream background to emphasize light and shadow. Dark trees frame the lower corners, while the castle's towers dominate the center against a light sky with faint cloud indications.

artworks.title: A Gondola on the Grand Canal, Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite with gouache on wove paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a canal scene in a bustling city. On the right, there are ornately decorated buildings with intricate carvings and balconies, adorned with colorful awnings and flags. The horizon is low, aligning with the rooftops under a clear blue sky. The water is turquoise and reflects the activity on the canal, with various small boats, including gondolas and sailing vessels. The brushstrokes are delicate and detailed, especially in depicting architectural elements and the rippling water. The color palette consists of azure blues, warm earth tones, and bright splashes of colors from fabrics and boat sails, contrasting with the sky and water.

artworks.title: A Winter Morning, Hoar Frost Melting
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image depicts a dense forest seen from a low vantage point. The perspective is looking upwards at tall trees with a high horizon line at the top. The trees are bare with some ivy, reaching towards a subdued sky, suggesting a late autumn or early winter setting. The painting's brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the textures of bark and leaves on the ground realistically. The color palette includes muted browns, greens, and grays, with hints of orange from fallen leaves and a soft yellowish sky. The forest floor is covered with dry leaves and moss-covered rocks, extending into more trees fading into the background.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: black and red chalks with pen and brown and gray ink on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nativity scene. The illustration features a group of figures gathered around a central individual. The central figure is holding or gesturing towards a radiant focal point. The scene is infused with a sense of reverence and focus, surrounded by characters observing the event. The backdrop includes architectural elements and figures in flowing robes. Above, there are cherubic figures on clouds. The intricate line work and delicate rendering suggest a thoughtful and detailed approach to the subject matter.

artworks.title: A Roman Ruin
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with brown, gray, and red wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Vincent J. Buonanno
artworks.description: The image shows a classical building with Corinthian columns and arched openings, surrounded by vegetation. Two figures are depicted fishing near the ruins. In the background, there are hills, trees, and sky rendered in muted tones. The artwork features delicate linework with watercolor or ink washes, creating a soft, atmospheric quality. The color palette includes earthy tones, grays, soft browns, and pale greens, evoking a historical ambiance.

artworks.title: Sculpture de griffon sur un chantier à Marseille (Sculpture of a Griffin on a construction site in Marseille)
artworks.medium: cyanotype
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicted in the image is a griffin, a mythological creature combining features of a lion and an eagle. The sculpture shows a lion's body with muscular legs and a curled tail, while its head and wings resemble an eagle's with detailed feather patterns. The sculpture is light-colored, possibly made of stone, contrasting against the blueish hue of the cyanotype background. It is placed outdoors on a rectangular plinth, facing away from an ornate building with large windows and intricate stonework, indicating an urban setting.

artworks.title: Sculpture de griffon sur un chantier à Marseille (Sculpture of a Griffin on a construction site in Marseille)
artworks.medium: cyanotype
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a roaring lion with its right front leg set forward on a base. The sculpture appears to be made of stone or a similar material. The entire image has a blue tone. The lion is positioned in front of a large, classical-style building with arched windows. Its detailed mane and powerful expression convey strength and majesty. The surrounding area includes wooden structures and scaffolding, suggesting construction activity.

artworks.title: Sculpture de griffon sur un chantier à Marseille (Sculpture of a Griffin on a construction site in Marseille)
artworks.medium: cyanotype
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture is of a winged lion with a human-like head and features. It is outdoors on a wooden platform or workbench in what appears to be a construction or renovation site, with a stone building facade and tools in the background. The sculpture is made of stone or similar solid material, as indicated by its smooth, polished surface and detailed carving. The color of the sculpture cannot be determined due to the monochromatic blue tone of the photograph. The creature is posed in a crouching position with one paw raised and wings unfurled.

artworks.title: Cattle in the Auvergne
artworks.medium: black and white chalk with stumping and touches of pastel on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of cattle on rugged terrain, with a view looking downward from a small elevation. In the background, there are dark hills or mountains, sparse trees, and dramatic clouds in the sky. The scene is depicted with smooth and meticulous brushstrokes, capturing details in the landscape and the cattle. The color palette is mainly earthy browns and ochres, creating a sepia-toned look that emphasizes the natural elements and the animals against the sky.

artworks.title: Study of the Virgin for an Annunciation
artworks.medium: brush with brown wash and white heightening over red chalk on laid paper; laid down on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated, with one arm extended towards the right side and the other arm slightly bent. Their face is not fully detailed but turned slightly in profile towards the extended arm. They have long flowing hair and are draped in a loose garment. In the background, there is a wall or curtain to the left and a table or ledge to the right with a flat, rectangular object on it. The scene is illuminated with a warm light from the right.

artworks.title: Vision of the Immaculate Conception
artworks.medium: brush with brown wash, pen and brown ink, and white heightening over black chalk on coarse laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund and Andrea Woodner Fund
artworks.description: The image features a central figure standing on a cloud, surrounded by angelic beings and an ethereal landscape. The figure stands upright with hands clasped in prayer, gazing upwards. This person has delicate facial features and curly hair. Draped in flowing robes, the figure exudes a sense of majesty. Encircling them are several angels; one hovers above holding a celestial sphere, while another supports the figure from below. Overhead, a bearded man is seated on a cloud with swirling drapery. The scene is framed by a backdrop of clouds and a bright light in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Ruined Gateway
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape view from an elevated vantage point, capturing architectural features and natural scenery. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky with delicate brushstrokes illustrating clouds. To the right, there is a large, somewhat dilapidated building with arched openings partly covered in foliage. Small, dark figures are scattered on the rugged terrain with loose, sketch-like strokes. In the middle, a river or path leads to a bridge with more figures visible. In the distance, there are buildings or ruins on a hill, with a faint mountain range on the horizon. The color palette is monochromatic using shades of sepia or black ink on a light tan or cream background.

artworks.title: The Refectory, Rievaulx Abbey, Yorkshire
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows the ruins of Rievaulx Abbey, Yorkshire. It shows an open space surrounded by stone walls and large arched windows. There are partial walls and arches in the distance, with vegetation growing throughout. The detailed etching captures the textures of stone and foliage with an emphasis on contrast and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring shades of grey and black.

artworks.title: The Chapterhouse, Fountains Abbey
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows the interior of an ancient, crumbling structure like an abbey or cathedral. There are arching columns with intricate details. The view leads to the outside where there are ruins covered in foliage. In the distance, more ruins can be seen with trees growing among them. The scene is monochromatic with rich contrasts and etching technique. Two figures are seen close to a column. The horizon is obscured by arches and vegetation, and the setting appears abandoned.
